description: BPL Hafen Töplitz is a series of datasets listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Brandenburg. Der Bebauungsplan setzt als verbindlicher Bauleitplan das Bodennutzungskonzept der Gemeinde in unmittelbar geltendes Recht um. Der Bebauungsplan gibt vor, welche Bodennutzungen auf den betroffenen Grundflächen zulässig und unzulässig sind. Coverage: Open Data Brandenburg. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Brandenburg. Its tags are bauleitplanung, bodennutzung, erdbeobachtung-und-umwelt, opendata, ressource. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
